audit_session: goal-2026-05-23 round-1 MEGA-S1 (post Phase A.1 commit d973a4b1e)

auditor_environment.browser_session_state: admin-auto-logged-in (dev convenience) — drove kiosk via Vue router push to bypass SPA admin-redirect

evidence_pre_heal.toast_text_captured: Trop de requêtes — patientez 30s avant de réessayer.
evidence_pre_heal.root_cause: Allowlist patterns ['/api/frontend/kiosk/event', '/api/admin/client-metrics'] use absolute paths, but axios stores baseURL ('/api') separately from config.url. At runtime error.config.url === 'frontend/kiosk-event' or '/frontend/kiosk/event' (NO /api prefix). String.includes() check therefore returns false on every real call shape → toast still fires.
evidence_pre_heal.discovery_methodology: Static analysis of bootstrap.js → empirical reproduction via mcp__playwright__browser_evaluate burst with 35 hyphen + 35 slash POSTs → DOM toast detection via .Vue-Toastification__toast selector

evidence_post_heal.verification_method: Same 70-call burst replayed post-heal, toast_count=0 captured

findings.title: Phase A.1 telemetry 429 allowlist fix (d973a4b1e) is structurally present but FUNCTIONALLY BROKEN at runtime — toast still surfaces despite fix landing
findings.evidence_file_line: resources/js/bootstrap.js:143-150 (pre-heal) — _TELEMETRY_ALLOWLIST_PATTERNS contained '/api/frontend/kiosk/event' + '/api/admin/client-metrics' (absolute paths). Axios config.url is the RELATIVE path because baseURL '/api' is stored separately. Empirical config.url values from real call shapes: 'frontend/kiosk-event', '/frontend/kiosk/event', 'frontend/kiosk/event' — none contain '/api/'. String.includes() returns false → 429 toast still fires.
findings.evidence_runtime_burst: Burst test 35 hyphen + 35 slash POSTs while logged in (with valid kiosk:order Sanctum token), observed 8+35=43 actual 429 responses AND 2 toasts displayed with text 'Trop de requêtes — patientez 30s avant de réessayer.' — root regression of Wave Final S1-002 P1 still present.
findings.persona_impact_detail: Client-impatient: visible toast 'Trop de requêtes' on borne idle/payment screen erodes V1 trust. Cashier-multitask: same toast on /admin surfaces during the same throttle burst signals false 'system overload' alarm.
findings.adversarial_dispute_outcome: kept-and-escalated-to-CRITICAL — pre-heal: this is exactly the kind of fix-induced false-green that the brief required this audit to catch. Sentinel passed at source level but the fix did not actually achieve its stated outcome. Post-heal: confirmed escalation was correct.
findings.fix_diff_summary: resources/js/bootstrap.js lines 143-160: replace ['/api/frontend/kiosk/event', '/api/admin/client-metrics'] with ['frontend/kiosk/event', 'frontend/kiosk-event', 'admin/client-metrics']. Covers all 6 kiosk call sites (KioskAppComponent x2, KioskPayment x3, KsConsentModal x2, KsA11ySettings x1, KioskCashInstruction x1, kioskPrinter x1, kioskOfflineQueue x1, useKioskA11y) + admin client-metrics PostHog batch sender. Source LOC delta: +13 lines (comments + 3 patterns), zero behavioral change to other interceptor branches. Bundle rebuilt via npm run dev (app.js, pos-app.js refreshed).
findings.sentinel_added: tests/js/sentinels/telemetryAllowlistSentinel.spec.js — added 4th assertion 'runtime check: _isTelemetryEndpoint matches the three actual call shapes' which extracts the live allowlist patterns and asserts each of the 3 real call-shape URLs hits at least one pattern via substring. Prevents future regression of the same shape.
findings.verification_status: GREEN post-fix: 70 burst calls produced 40 server 429s but ZERO user-visible toasts. 8/8 sentinel tests pass.

findings.title: Subtitle copy 'CHOISISSEZ UNE OPTION POUR COMMENCER' very faint on orange gradient — likely sub-WCAG 4.5:1
findings.evidence_file_line: Kiosk idle screen — bottom caption rendered in white/pale color on gradient orange-coral background. Visible in S1-V1-idle-1366x900.jpeg around y=1015px.
findings.adversarial_dispute_outcome: kept — borderline but real. The subtitle is contextual guidance, not the primary CTA. Mitigated by the prominent CTA + 'À emporter' card. The text is white over an orange gradient that ranges from ~#F4D0AF (light) to ~#F4501E (saturated). At the gradient bottom (saturated) contrast might be acceptable; at lighter mid-gradient it drops below 4.5:1.
findings.defer_decision: PROPOSAL drafted, defer to V1.0.2 — non-blocking, single text element, borderline contrast

findings.title: Left-rail category icons appear visually identical (same burger illustration) — reduces wayfinding affordance
findings.evidence_file_line: Kiosk categories /kiosk/categories — left nav rail shows 10 category cards (SANDWICH CAYENNE, GALETTE, SANDWICH CLASSIQUE, BURGERS, TACOS, BOLS GOURMANDS, MENU ENFANT, FRITES, SUPPLÉMENTS, DESSERTS, BOISSONS), all showing what looks like the same burger icon at small size.
findings.adversarial_dispute_outcome: kept-conditionally — at this thumbnail resolution the icons compress visually similar. May be intentional (no per-category icon available in DB) or may be a fallback. The TEXT label below each (SANDWICH/BURGERS/TACOS) carries the wayfinding load. Real customer impact low because users scan by label, not icon. Conformant with 'no useless complexity V1'.
findings.data_check_required: Verify if Category model has icon/image field populated for V1 catalog — if not, this is a data backlog not a code change
findings.defer_decision: INFO — data backlog item. No code change needed at audit scope. Suggest catalog-team add per-category icon assets when V1.0.2 catalog refresh runs.

findings.title: GET /api/login → 401 on kiosk idle page load — browser autofill probe (pre-existing INFO, carried from Wave Final S1-001)
findings.evidence_file_line: Console error captured post-fix on /kiosk/idle: 'Failed to load resource: 401 Unauthorized @ http://localhost:8000/api/login:0'. No matching axios call site in resources/js/. Likely browser-side Saved-Passwords autofill probe.
findings.adversarial_dispute_outcome: kept-as-INFO (carried from Wave Final S1-001) — no application source, no DOM toast, no business impact. The 401 is an environmental browser-runtime artifact, not a backend or frontend defect.

findings.title: Kiosk cart accepts an item but recomputes price to €0,00 when composition_snapshot lacks valid item lineage
findings.evidence_file_line: Test injected fake item id=12 via store.dispatch('kioskCart/addItem') from /kiosk/categories context. /kiosk/cart rendered '1 article' + 'Cheddar' but with €0,00 unit and total. itemCount getter returned 0. Sous-total/Total/Valider button all show €0,00.
findings.adversarial_dispute_outcome: discarded-as-CORRECT-NF525-BEHAVIOR — this is desired security: backend pricing SSOT refuses to accept a frontend-injected price/composition. The cart line renders 'Cheddar 1 article' visually but the pricing collapses to €0,00 because the backend pricing service won't validate an unauthenticated composition_snapshot. Frontend cannot inject prices. This is exactly the NF525 invariant from CLAUDE.md §8 working as designed.
findings.info_note: Real user flow goes through KioskWizardComponent which builds composition_snapshot with proper option references; price is then computed server-side. The test bypass only confirms the guard holds.

findings.title: Security posture verified — kiosk:order ability scoped, BranchScope active, Echo TLS-less in dev only
findings.evidence_file_line: window.foodkingConfig branch_count=1 (single-tenant V1 single-resto), kioskAutoLogin payload present (gated by APP_ENV=local + IP allowlist per config/kiosk.php:155-186), Sanctum token starts with '1011|...' format. ws://127.0.0.1:6001 is local Soketi (TLS-less expected in local dev, never in prod).
findings.adversarial_dispute_outcome: kept-INFO — no defect. Audit confirms guards are active. The kiosk-auto-login machine credentials are gated by config/kiosk.php:155-186 (APP_ENV=local OR IP-allowlisted, NEVER both-public). Sanctum token scoped to ['kiosk:order'] ability per CLAUDE.md §9.

verdict_rationale: Round 1 surfaced 1 CRITICAL fix-induced regression that the Phase A.1 commit d973a4b1e claimed to close but EMPIRICALLY DOES NOT (toast still fires under 429 burst). Root cause: allowlist pattern format mismatch — patterns used absolute /api paths but axios config.url is the relative form. Healed inline in same audit session: new patterns + new runtime-shape sentinel + rebuilt bundle + empirical verification (0 toasts on identical burst). All other lenses returned strong baselines (24/0 button aria, 20/0 image alt, 0 raw i18n keys, FR-only, branch_count=1, Echo connected, Sanctum scoped). Two minor visual/UX findings (S1-V-002 idle subtitle contrast borderline → PROPOSAL frozen file; S1-V-003 category icons identical-looking → data backlog INFO). Production-real lens: cliente 50 ans claustrophobe would NOT notice the toast post-heal (because there is none) and the FR copy + price integrity (€7,80 carries cleanly across cart→payment→cash-instruction per Wave Final prior verification) gives confidence. NF525 invariant verified intact (cart refuses frontend-injected pricing). Phase A.1 outcome restored to its stated promise.
phase_a1_verification_outcome: Initial fix DID NOT HOLD; healed in same session; final state passes 70-call burst with 0 toasts.

scope_minimal_changes_made.rationale: GOAL-D1-FIX heal — replace absolute /api allowlist patterns with relative-URL patterns matching axios config.url shape. Adds defensive comment block explaining root cause.
Sentinel hardening — add 4th behavioural test that asserts allowlist matches the 3 real config.url shapes. Refactor 2 existing assertions to match new pattern format.
Webpack bundle rebuild via 'npm run dev' to ship the heal at runtime. app.js is .gitignored (no commit needed); pos-app.js + mix-manifest.json tracked, will be committed.
